verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows an extensive, shipping official SDK/runtime ecosystem (Ryzen AI Software, ONNX Runtime + Vitis AI EP, AMD Quark quantization toolkit, Lemonade SDK, GAIA agent framework, AI Analyzer) enabling real NPU/hybrid/GPU LLM deployment today, clearly satisfying the 'official SDK/runtime ships today' half of the story. However, no citation in the pack states a published TOPS figure with precision for the NPU — the docs describe execution modes (NPU-only, hybrid, BF16/INT4 quantization) but never quote a TOPS number. Missing for 10: an explicit published TOPS figure with stated precision (e.g., 'XX TOPS INT8') for the NPU.
